# truenas_user (Data Source)

Fetches a TrueNAS local user by username.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Username to look up.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean)
- `email` (String)
- `full_name` (String)
- `group` (Number) Primary group ID for the user.
- `groups` (List of Number)
- `home` (String)
- `id` (Number) Numeric user ID.
- `immutable` (Boolean)
- `local` (Boolean)
- `locked` (Boolean)
- `password_disabled` (Boolean)
- `shell` (String)
- `smb` (Boolean)
- `ssh_password_enabled` (Boolean)
- `sshpubkey` (String)
- `sudo_commands` (List of String)
- `sudo_commands_nopasswd` (List of String)
- `uid` (Number) UNIX UID.
